query: How should an embedded app recognize an install-time OAuth grant without asking the user for consent again?

candidates.text: Embedded extensions can request a short-lived ID token from the host and send it to your backend, which resolves it with the platform's token-resolve endpoint to identify the user and link them to your app's account without another consent screen.
Workspace plans include Starter, Core, Growth and Agency tiers billed monthly or annually.
Apps use the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow; after the user authorizes, the platform redirects to your redirect URI with a code you exchange for an access token.
